registrationContext: Registered after the trial began and after inspecting its first 68 persisted attempts, before the scheduled 72-hour endpoint. Not a pre-trial preregistration.

methods.replay: Replay each archived attempt against its exact publicSnapshotHash using the unchanged experiment code; require exact row and final-state equality.
methods.coverage: Report occupied fixed 60-second slots since trial activation, considering only completed slots by the explicit evaluation cutoff. Also report gaps and unobserved tails. Slot occupancy is not continuous uptime or seconds of availability.
methods.offerUsability: Report VALID distinct accepted observations separately from invalid, missing/duplicate-package, stale/input-error and repeated-source observations. Do not equate an omitted package with confirmed available:false.
methods.streaks: A usable streak requires same-series quotes with both source and receipt gaps satisfying the already-frozen trial rule. Report observation counts and endpoint spans, not a proven continuous condition.
methods.episodes: Use the exact replayed candidate and three-observation confirmation labels. Include every candidate, interruptions, unconfirmed episodes and right-censoring; no winner-only selection.
methods.latency: Report time from observations to the collector's batch report generation where known. This is not Git publication time, push delivery, execution latency or proof of tradeability.
methods.decision: While the trial clock is running, all results are interim. After expiry, report coverage limitations and recorded events without automatic promotion, threshold adjustment or profit inference. No new arbitrary minimum-event or profitability gate is introduced.

fixedMetricUnits.return: conditional modeled reward divided by cost, not realized profit
